name: Science Fiction
description: Declarative science-fiction preset. Abstract technological speculation; no living-author imitation.
purpose: Keep speculation causal: a changed condition must produce social, ethical, or survival consequences.
writing_goals: Make the novum alter daily life, not just scenery
Let method and constraint be visible enough to feel fair
Test characters against systems they cannot simply wish away
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Use abstract narrative style, not a named living voice
Infodump before the human problem is live
Society unchanged despite a civilization-scale invention
checklist: The governing constraint of the novum is stated
Later scenes still obey that constraint
Social effects match the scale of the invention

pacing_tendency.value: idea-then-consequence; allow explanation only when it changes a decision

description_tendency.value: concrete artifacts and procedures over cosmic abstraction

dialogue_tendency.value: competence and disagreement about method; avoid lecture unless a character is lecturing
